title: close-cards: the open-PR-references skip counts pm:mailbox PRs, which mention card numbers in knocks, so cards are falsely skipped
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a measured tool defect (triage, 2026-11-15 p3 review). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

`scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs` skips a card when an open pull request cross-references it (`--skip-pr-referenced`, default on, reading timeline `cross-referenced` events). Seat mailboxes are open pull requests labelled `pm:mailbox`, and knocks mention card numbers. So a card a seat merely mentioned in a mailbox knock reads as "an open PR references it" and is skipped:
- #32903 was skipped for PR #32727 (`pm:mailbox — domain:server#1`);
- #33035 was skipped for PR #32588 (triage's own mailbox);
- #33850 was skipped for #33915 and #32588.

The work-around is `--no-skip-pr-referenced`, which also drops the real protection for every other card in the plan.

## Change

Exclude open pull requests labelled `pm:mailbox` (and any `pm:seat` post) from the referenced-by set. A real PR that names the card keeps the skip. Add a self-test row for a mailbox-only reference.

`scripts/pm/**` is not governed; the seat lands it after review.
